independent_tools.tools/search-anchor-audit.rs: Copy to crates/hotaru-core/tests/anchor_audit_tmp.rs in an isolated workspace; includes3minimal reproducers plus60-seed invariant.

fixed_findings: Synthetic final newline can map to immutable history but depend on active continuation.
Deferred spaces/newlines can map to history but depend on later active text flushing them.
Pruning earlier blank or text context can change Ghostty-compatible newline coordinates even if reported endpoints survive.
resolution: Track generation-sensitive matches as a newest retained prefix; emission dependencies advance monotonically through rows.
Require refresh for newline-containing queries when origin changes; cache multiline classification once so resolve stays O(1).
Preserve epoch/origin rebase for stable historical single-line matches.
